entries.title: Every season on the Races page, 2019 to 2026 (175 races): the years before INDY NXT folded under their year's dots, or open

values.label: folded (default): each year 2019-2023 shows its dots, one per race coloured by series, and a 'Show the N races' button opens its rows
open: every year's rows listed under its dots, all 175 rows on the page

entries.look: Races. Use the year links under the title to jump; point at (or tap) any dot in any season for the track card; open 2019 and click a race; open a DNF/DNS race (2019 Watkins Glen Race 3) to see its own page.
entries.replacedBy: 2023 and earlier behind one disclosure under the INDY NXT seasons: closed by default, opens in place (nothing above it moves), keyboard and touch; a year link or an address ending #season-2019 opens it at that year

entries.title: The track on each Races row: the 3D still with the lap drawn bold in ink, or round seven's bird's-eye icon

values.label: bold-line still (default): the venue's 3D still cropped to the track, the lap drawn bold in ink on its centreline, so it reads at row size; a quiet blank tile where no model exists yet
bird's-eye icon (round seven): the model from straight above with a bold line; the 2D line where no icon exists

entries.look: Races → open 2019 (all 30 rows now have a picture) and any INDY NXT season's rows; flip to icon and compare how the track reads at row size.
